verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents pre-built integrations with major commerce/payment platforms (Amazon FBA, BigCommerce, Ebay, Magento 2, Netsuite, PayPal, Shopify, Square, Stripe, Woocommerce) and pricing tiers explicitly counting 'total integrations,' showing these are maintained connectors rather than developer-built plumbing. Missing for 10: no per-integration setup docs or changelogs demonstrating active maintenance, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of integration reliability beyond one community mention.
